scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run build -w @suits/motion-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @suits/analysis-api
scripts.lint: eslint src tests server/src server/tests shared/motion-diagnostics/*.ts *.config.*
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests server/src server/tests server/*.md server/package.json server/tsconfig*.json shared/motion-diagnostics/*.ts shared/motion-diagnostics/*.json *.config.* package.json tsconfig*.json README.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests server/src server/tests server/*.md server/package.json server/tsconfig*.json shared/motion-diagnostics/*.ts shared/motion-diagnostics/*.json *.config.* package.json tsconfig*.json README.md docs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run format:check && npm run analysis:test
scripts.analysis:dev: npm run build -w @suits/motion-contracts && npm run dev -w @suits/analysis-api
scripts.analysis:build: npm run build -w @suits/motion-contracts && npm run build -w @suits/analysis-api
scripts.analysis:provider-check: npm run build -w @suits/motion-contracts && npm run provider:check -w @suits/analysis-api
scripts.analysis:prepare: npm run build -w @suits/motion-contracts && npm run prepare:recording -w @suits/analysis-api --
